info.name: Returns a list of users in SCIM format according to RFC 7644

params.name: filter
params.description:
SCIM filter expression to filter users. Supports the following operators:
- `eq` (equals): Checks if attribute equals value (e.g., `userName eq "foo@example.com"`)
- `ne` (not equals): Checks if attribute is not equal to value (e.g., `active ne true`)
- `co` (contains): Checks if attribute contains substring (e.g., `userName co "example"`)
- `sw` (starts with): Checks if attribute starts with substring (e.g., `name.givenName sw "J"`)
- `ew` (ends with): Checks if attribute ends with substring (e.g., `name.familyName ew "son"`)
- `gt` (greater than): For numeric/date values (e.g., `meta.lastModified gt "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z"`)
- `lt` (less than): For numeric/date values (e.g., `meta.lastModified lt "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"`)
- `ge` (greater or equal): For numeric/date values
- `le` (less or equal): For numeric/date values

Logical operators: `and`, `or`, `not` can be used to combine conditions.

items.docs: Retrieves all users from the specified account in SCIM format. Supports filtering by various user attributes.

info.name: Creates a new user in SCIM format

params.name: slug
params.description: Account slug to create a user in.

items.docs: Creates a new SCIM user in the specified account (RFC 7643/7644). Requires the core User schema and the ValiMail user extension schema. Supports userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, optional externalId, and extension memberType. Allowed memberType values are 'owner' and 'member'; 'marketer' is accepted only when enabled for the account. Returns 409 when userName already exists and 400 for invalid or missing fields.

info.name: Returns a single user in SCIM format

items.docs: Retrieves a specific user by ID from the specified account in SCIM format, including all user attributes and ValiMail-specific extensions.

info.name: Updates a user's attributes using SCIM PATCH operation

params.name: slug
params.description: Account slug of the user to update.

items.docs:
Partially updates an existing SCIM user (RFC 7644 PatchOp).

Supported operations:
- op: "replace" only

Supported paths:
- active (boolean: true/false)
- urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:valimailuserextension:2.0:User.memberType
  (owner, member, or marketer when enabled for the account)

Requirements:
- schemas must include "urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"

Notes:
- PUT is not supported for this endpoint.
- Unsupported op/path/value returns 400.
